verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no sandbox or test environment that isolates agent or user testing from production Model data. Nearby features are scenarios for what-if planning, undoable writes with a changelog, and per-tool allow/ask/deny approval policies. These are adjacent controls: modeling inside the live Model, rollback after a change, and approval gating. None of them provides an isolated environment, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
